assets.notes: The public signing certificates of Google Play services' font provider, which GoogleFont.Provider needs to verify the provider. Copied unchanged. The app requests Google Fonts only when the user picks one in Settings > Appearance > App font; Play services downloads them, the app has no INTERNET permission.
